text: Oh, we've got some guests! Welcome, welcome!
You'll be pranked if you don't give us sweets,\npom!
Yeah, it's a long story, but this is just how\nthings are in this world.
Um, okay. I can't believe you have time to\ndeal with this kind of stuff.\nI see you're a curious one too, huh?
Wait, we won't get pranked if we give 'em sweets,\nright? But why this thing makes it sound like\nwe'll always get pranked, tho?
Since we've taken the time to prepare the prank...
We'd like you to enjoy it too, pom!
Heyyy! Please say something!\nYou make me feel uneasy, you know!!
You got away before the monsters gathered!
The atmosphere here is pretty nice...\nIt's amazing that you created this place.
Oh, actually we found it by chance.
No one was here, so we decided to reuse it, pom.
Wait, that's not reusing, it's more like\ntrespassing, you know? But well, I guess it's fine\nsince no one lives here.
We've got no choice, let's head over there!
Was this part damaged too before?
Find [ffff64]Olant and Potumkin's Fragment Sweets[ffffff] without\ngetting discovered by the roaming monsters!
Wait, where did those two go?
Uh? I have no idea. I thought they were with us...
They probably got separated from us on the way\nhere and none of noticed that.
Jeez, I guess we have no choice.
Jacky and I will go look for them over there.\nYou guys please search somewhere else!
This is getting troublesome. But if I just let it\nbe, I won't make any profit...
There is a cape, and a lot of cookie crumbs all\nover the place...
Whoaah!! Stay away from me, pom!!
You can skip the searching part if you can't\nclear it.
W-whoaa! T-they're here too!\nWhere the hey did the come from?!
A-anyway, we'll knock them down if they attack!
There is a pumpkin hat and a lot of candy crumbs\nall over the place...
That round thing was wearing this, wasn't it...?
How was it? Did you guys find anything?
We didn't find anything at all...\nAnyway, what's with all those sweets?
Er, these things belong to those two, right?
What the hey is going on...?
Oh, no way, this is endless!
You got away before the monsters gathered!
